verifies.G063-C1: for four associations of one entity the wizard offers, per association, New Class (a separate record file), New Nested Class (a public nested record, implicitly static), Existing Class (a DTO already in the project, selected by name) and Flat (inner fields become top-level components); each choice is applied in the created files. The DTO is always a Java record (a nested record is the record form of a nested static class); a to-many association cannot be flat; the existing class is referenced by name and its fields are not verified. The window layout of the original (one tree dialog) is not checked.
